decoding.note: Thinking disabled both by the server and by per-request enable_thinking=false.

grading.canonical_text_correct: Normalized visible response exactly matches the canonical US-English rendering.
grading.instruction_compliant: Complete visible response contains only valid English-number syntax.
grading.numeric_correct: Complete visible response parses as number words and equals the integer sum.

pair_selection: 30 independent direct integer draws with replacement within each ordered digit-length cell; 0 excluded for one-digit operands
prompt_template: What is {a} + {b}? Please write your answer in words. Do not include any other text or information, just the answer in words.
request_order: all 5,070 frozen cases shuffled once before inference
